answer: A registry atlas maps every funding root as a separate island: each fresh identity must post 500 POA bond held 6 epochs in escrow, backed by 2 distinct vouchers with separate history. A whisper of gossip counts as attestation weight only from outside the author's island, and each island supplies at most 1 of 4 quorum votes, so fifty fake keys on one island weigh one. Peers audit real work each epoch; a failed audit will slash the bond, burn the holdback and eject the key. Ten islands cost ten bonds, ten waits, ten histories for one vote.
